support_claim: The billing record and SOW-VEL-2022 each name 'Vellum Print Co Ltd', but the packet provides no evidence beyond this shared name to establish that the billing referent and the contract referent denote the same legal counterparty.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity and name similarity alone is insufficient; the packet cites matching names in billing and as the SOW counterparty but offers no further linkage (e.g., registration identifier, explicit cross-reference). DISTINCT likewise requires evidence of distinctness, which is absent, so neither burden is met and UNRESOLVED is licensed.
